summary: PASS. The DG0 specification is faithful to the playbook and master prompt. The docx extraction is complete (1001 of 1001 segments; 49 tables and 239 rows). All 165 B and 423 M blocks are dispositioned correctly. T01–T16 columns and every source value list are verbatim. All first-class deliverables are fully specified. The operating-logic semantics are stated correctly and testably. There are no invented source requirements and no claims of official PMI status or Mobily branding. The staging follows §21, and prefreeze.sh DG0 passes on a fresh clone. All ten of my earlier findings (F-DG0-001 to 010) are re-verified CLOSED_VERIFIED against their pre-fix commits. New: F-DG0-011 (Low, non-mandatory; REQ-DLV-002's procedure wording says every agent definition states the no-business-approval rule, while the definitions only incorporate it by reference). I would accept it as an observation.
